As the weekend approaches again, this AirPods Pro 3 is still available at a 25% discount, and the AirPods Max 2 also has a $100 direct discount. However, today's top story on 9to5Toys Lunch Break is the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returning to $1,099 through the official Apple Refurbished Store, with all three colours in stock (saving $200) — you'll need to act fast, as this model usually sells out quickly. We also have the newer MacBook Neo with savings of up to $120, an Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop nearly $100 off on Amazon, and the latest 240W braided Beats USB-C cable down to $18 with Prime shipping at an Amazon low (40% off). Don't forget to check out the updated 2026 Best Buy Back to School deals while you still can — see below for details.

AirPods summer deals continue: Max 2 down $100, AirPods Pro 3 25% off, from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)
  • AirPods 4 (with ANC) $149 (original price $179)
  • AirPods 4 (with ANC) $119 (original price $179 new) — Renewed Premium

Best Buy updates 2026 Back to School deals: TVs under $500, Bose down $130, Apple products, Ninja kitchen appliances, and more

Cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returns to $1,099 through official Apple Refurbished Store, with all three colours in stock (saving $200)

The official Apple Refurbished Store has long been a great place to save money, as the MacBook lineup has seen price increases at the retail level. Stock for the base configurations of the Pro and M5 MacBook Air series comes and goes, but this morning we saw the base 13-inch M5 MacBook Air in all three colours ready to go at $1,099 — that's $200 below its listed price.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is currently selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage with shipping at $1,099. At the time of writing, this offer is available for the Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue models.

These products come with the following:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare purchase
  • Apple's rigorous refurbishment process performed prior to sale

What you're looking at here is the base M5 MacBook Air configuration, which has a new unit price of $1,299. Today's Apple Refurbished Store offer is $200 below the new unit price and is the lowest price we've found for any current-generation model.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (original price $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

This is the Apple Refurbished Store, arguably the best place to buy a refurbished MacBook Air on the market, but how does it compare to current retail new unit prices?

Amazon is currently charging nearly full price for this configuration, with only the silver model coming in slightly lower at $1,240. While there was a time when this machine sold for less than this, we haven't seen Amazon's new unit price drop below $1,149 since the price increase, and even then it was an extremely brief deal about a month ago.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop now nearly $100 off on Amazon

If I may say so, two of the best-looking smartwatch pairings on the planet are both nearly $100 off on Amazon right now — namely, the Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with the Milanese Loop, available in Natural Titanium and Black.

While the cheaper Ocean Band configuration's $100 discount has disappeared, Amazon is currently selling the Natural or Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop at $799.99 with shipping.

These two configurations carry a $899 price tag thanks to the woven steel Milanese Loop, but are now nearly $100 off under Amazon's deal:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (original price $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (original price $899)

The outside world expects Apple to launch its next-generation Ultra wearable next month, but RAM price hikes have already hit the iPad and MacBook lineups, and the new Apple Watch could be the next victim. The existing product line hasn't been affected for now, but since they're essentially mini computers on your wrist, the Ultra 4/Series 12 could be next.

We absolutely wouldn't blame anyone for wanting to wait and see what else Apple has in store for September, but in less than a month, these items could be more expensive than ever.

The Series models are likely to be the same, and they also have $100 discounts available on Amazon:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

Grab the latest 240W braided Beats USB-C cable, down to an Amazon low of $18 with Prime shipping (40% off)

While the 240W black version is still at the all-time low of $18 with Prime shipping, hurry and grab a few 10-foot Beats braided USB-C cables.

Amazon currently has the latest 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C braided cable priced at $18.03, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

These 2026 models with an upgraded power supply rating are priced at $30, and frankly, even high-end 10-foot USB-C cables are a bit pricey. But at a 40% discount off the listed price, I think everyone's EDC or home collection should include a few of these higher-end, better-looking models.

Today's main low price is the Bolt Black version, but there's also the Navy version at $19, the Surge Stone version at $20.85 after clipping the page coupon, and the red version at just under $24.

As mentioned above, this is the latest model, upgraded from the previous generation's 60W to a powerful 240W power supply, extended to 10 feet, while retaining the same tangle-resistant braided design: "More durable, more convenient. Upgrade your charging experience and say goodbye to tangles, kinks, and wear and tear — choose our reinforced braided cable."

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular models with $100 discount, deal from $299

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand returns to Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

After testing this model earlier this year, Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a permanent fixture in my EDC, travel bag, and home charging setup. Now nearly 35% off, we again have a chance to grab it at the lowest Amazon price we've tracked.

The official Anker Amazon Store is currently selling the latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger at $99.97 with shipping.

Priced at $150, this charging device features 3-in-1 functionality, with the MagSafe charging pad offering up to 25W output, and both the Phantom Gray/Black and Radiant White versions are nearly 35% off the listed price.

This week's deal is the same as the one mentioned last time, matching Anker's big summer sale and this year's Prime Day pricing.

Although this device is small and easy to carry, it has a bit of weight to it, so it can sit securely on your desk or bedside table, performing well whether at your home workstation or out and about.

  • Belkin's brand-new compact 100W USB-C MacBook GaN charger with 5-foot cable down to just $25
  • Power all the devices on your desk for just $60 with this SABRENT 252W 8-port charging station (all-time low)
  • Baseus 20,000mAh 100W laptop power bank with dual built-in cables slashed to $33 (58% off)
  • Acer braided USB/Thunderbolt 4 Type-C cable supports 240W charging, 8K, and more, slashed to $16
  • Anker 140W 4-port MacBook charger with smart display, today down to just $56
  • First deal: Brand-new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro lock with Ultra Wideband auto-unlock
  • KeySmart transparent 'Ghost' SmartCard Find My wallet tracker card returns to Amazon low
  • Spigen mini MagSafe iPhone backpack / EDC organiser bag down to $27
  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter works in 'over 200 countries and regions', down to $20

Official Apple Refurbished Store has MacBook Neo at lowest prices, up to $120 off listed price

In addition to the MacBook Air and M5 MacBook Pro lineup, Apple's lower-priced newer MacBook Neo has also seen price increases recently, but you can sidestep this increase through the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store — the MacBook Neo starts at $689 on Amazon, but you can buy models with full Apple warranty through Apple's best refurbished store starting from $599.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store offers all MacBook Neo configurations, at the lowest price we've found from any reputable store, with the same official Apple warranty and Apple's 'rigorous' refurbished quality certification.

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (original price $699 new)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (original price $799 new)

Although there doesn't seem to be any special deals on the Apple Refurbished Store product pages, they are all at least $100 below the current MSRP — the 512GB model with Touch ID keyboard is actually $120 below the current listed price, and also $20 below the previous price.

Yes, these are refurbished units, and yes, they're just bringing the prices back to close to the old MSRP, but this is the lowest price for the cheapest current-generation MacBook.

For some people, saving $100 to $120 isn't worth choosing a refurbished machine, and that's completely understandable, but it's certainly not a small sum, and we're talking about the highest-quality refurbished units available directly from Apple.
